title: Конфигурация верхней панели (Top Bar)
description: Страница для управления настройками верхней панели приложения.
//_comment_dataSources: Loads the top-bar-settings.json file. Initializes with default structure on error.

showToast.detail: Не удалось загрузить конфигурацию Top Bar: {{error.message}}

//_comment_actions: Manages CRUD operations for top bar items and global settings saving.

actions.//_comment_saveChanges: Saves the entire top bar configuration.

showToast.detail: Не удалось сохранить конфигурацию Top Bar: {{error.message}}

actions.//_comment_openItemForm: Prepares and shows a dialog/form for adding or editing an item from either leftItems or rightItems list. `itemIndex` is null for new items.

actions.//_comment_submitItemForm: Handles saving the item from the form. If itemIndex is provided, it updates an existing item; otherwise, it adds a new item to the specified list (leftItems or rightItems).

actions.//_comment_deleteItem: Deletes an item from the specified list (leftItems or rightItems) at the given index.

//_comment_body: Main page layout: Toolbar for saving, TabView for Left Items, Right Items, and Global Settings.

body.//_comment_save_toolbar: Global save button for all top bar configurations.

body.//_comment_main_tabs: Tabs for managing left items, right items, and global settings of the top bar.

children.//_comment_left_items_panel: Panel for managing items displayed on the left side of the top bar.

children.//_comment_add_left_item_toolbar: Toolbar with a button to add a new item to the left side.

children.//_comment_left_items_loop: Loops through leftItems and displays each in a card.

children.//_comment_item_card: Card displaying details of a single top bar item. Assumes edit/delete buttons are in the card footer (not shown in partial view).

children.//_comment_item_details: Displays common and type-specific details for the item.

then.//_comment_unknown_type_fallback: Fallback to display other properties if item type is not one of the known types.
